exit_codes.1: manifest has validation errors, including a sign-off already expired at --as-of
exit_codes.2: usage error, unreadable file, or unparseable YAML

invalid.expect_message: a sign-off with no end date is not a periodic review
cannot be signed off before it was carried out
does not account for every record it claims to cover

collapses_to.tool: a single batch ingest that takes reviewed attestations and files their evidence records together; individual records are already idempotency-keyed and carry expiry at creation

idempotency.verified_at: Noru's createEvidence contract accepts idempotencyKey, scopes it by organization and operation, returns the original evidence id for identical retries, and rejects the same key with a changed payload. The description marker remains a compatibility probe for deployments predating that contract.
idempotency.fallback: client_probe: description contains the content marker

idempotency.verified_at: The updateEvidence tool updates an existing evidence record by id. The plugin emits this repair only when its current-state probe shows expiry drift; first-time sign-off creation already includes expiry atomically.
idempotency.gap: Noru does not expose a conditional update token for evidence expiry, so the plugin probes current state before repairing a manually changed expiry. Repeating the same patch cannot create another record.

source.note: The organization's controls and their status. Ids come from Noru; this plugin ships none.

The full context for one control: what the framework expects, what is already linked, coverage, and the procedure an auditor follows. The difference between expected and linked is the first half of the queue.

Every evidence record linked to a control with its owner, status, type and expiry. The expired and nearly-expired ones are the second half of the queue: a review that went stale is due again, and only Noru knows when.
The catalogue of framework-level evidence-item templates, used to resolve titles and types for items the control context returns by id.

exit_codes.1: drift, validation failure, an expired sign-off under --as-of, missing prerequisite input, or a stale plan
exit_codes.2: usage error, including a push without --confirm
